name: X-linked intellectual disability-Dandy-Walker malformation-basal ganglia disease-seizures syndrome
aliases: X-linked intellectual disability with Dandy-Walker malformation and basal ganglia disease

criteria.description: Presence of moderate to severe intellectual disability
Neuroimaging evidence of Dandy-Walker malformation characterized by hypoplasia of the cerebellar vermis and cystic dilatation of the fourth ventricle
Clinical and/or radiological evidence of basal ganglia involvement including movement disorders
Recurrent seizures of variable types starting in infancy or early childhood
X-linked inheritance pattern with affected males and carrier females

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of intellectual disability, Dandy-Walker malformation on imaging, basal ganglia disease, and seizures in a male patient with suggestive family history
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by neuroimaging and genetic testing

laboratory: Possible mild metabolic abnormalities during seizures
imaging: MRI showing Dandy-Walker malformation with cerebellar vermis hypoplasia and cystic dilation of the fourth ventricle
Basal ganglia abnormalities including signal changes or volume loss
genetic: X-linked inheritance pattern confirmed by family studies

distinguishingFeatures: Predominantly basal ganglia involvement without intellectual disability
Severe epilepsy with basal ganglia changes

redFlags: Early onset seizures refractory to treatment
Family history of affected males with intellectual disability and brain malformations
references: Orphanet: X-linked intellectual disability-Dandy-Walker malformation-basal ganglia disease-seizures syndrome (ORPHA:1568)
Recent literature on X-linked intellectual disability syndromes with brain malformations
